benchmark_record_id: title:environmental dna reveals seasonal occupancy of a threatened stream salamander|year:2026
title: Environmental DNA reveals seasonal occupancy of a threatened stream salamander
abstract: We collected 1-L water samples from 42 headwater sites in spring and autumn and extracted environmental DNA from membrane filters. A species-specific ddPCR assay detected salamander DNA at 19 sites, including seven where visual surveys failed. Detection probability increased after rainfall and was incorporated into an occupancy model.
gold_note: Direct environmental water eDNA collection and species detection.

benchmark_record_id: title:marine environmental dna maps a coastal shark nursery|year:2026
title: Marine environmental DNA maps a coastal shark nursery
abstract: Seawater was sampled along a 120-km coastal transect and filtered aboard the survey vessel. Environmental DNA metabarcoding and a shark-specific qPCR assay were used to compare juvenile shark occurrence with acoustic detections. eDNA detections were concentrated in shallow embayments used as nursery habitat.
gold_note: Direct seawater eDNA survey.

benchmark_record_id: title:sedimentary edna tracks century-scale turnover in alpine lake fish|year:2026
title: Sedimentary eDNA tracks century-scale turnover in alpine lake fish
abstract: Sediment cores were sectioned at 1-cm intervals and DNA was extracted under ancient-DNA clean-room conditions. Fish environmental DNA was amplified with short mitochondrial markers and compared with historical stocking records. The sedaDNA record showed replacement of native assemblages after repeated introductions.
gold_note: Sedimentary environmental DNA is directly analyzed.

benchmark_record_id: title:airborne environmental dna detects mammals in a temperate forest|year:2026
title: Airborne environmental DNA detects mammals in a temperate forest
abstract: Air samplers operated for 24 h at 18 forest plots. DNA recovered from collection filters was analyzed using vertebrate metabarcoding, yielding detections of deer, fox, squirrel, and several bat taxa. Replicate airborne eDNA samples showed higher detection consistency near animal trails.
gold_note: Airborne eDNA sampling and metabarcoding.

benchmark_record_id: title:environmental rna captures diel gene-expression signals released by reef fish|year:2026
title: Environmental RNA captures diel gene-expression signals released by reef fish
abstract: Seawater was collected every three hours around reef mesocosms and immediately preserved for RNA extraction. Environmental RNA was reverse-transcribed and assayed for a clock-gene transcript together with mitochondrial RNA. Transcript abundance in water followed the expected diel phase observed in source fish.
gold_note: Direct eRNA collection and transcript detection.

benchmark_record_id: title:passive samplers improve environmental dna detection in turbid rivers|year:2026
title: Passive samplers improve environmental DNA detection in turbid rivers
abstract: We compared grab-water filtration with enclosed cellulose passive samplers deployed for 6, 24, and 72 h at eight river sites. Environmental DNA from both approaches was analyzed by fish metabarcoding. Passive samplers increased taxon detections at low DNA concentrations but accumulated more PCR inhibitors after 72 h.
gold_note: eDNA sampling-method comparison.

benchmark_record_id: title:droplet digital pcr quantifies invasive mussel environmental dna below visual detection|year:2026
title: Droplet digital PCR quantifies invasive mussel environmental DNA below visual detection
abstract: Water was sampled upstream and downstream of an invasion front. A newly validated ddPCR assay quantified environmental DNA from the target mussel with no amplification in tested non-target species. Low-copy detections preceded settlement-plate observations by several weeks.
gold_note: Species-specific eDNA assay.

benchmark_record_id: title:soil environmental dna identifies burrowing mammal activity|year:2026
title: Soil environmental DNA identifies burrowing mammal activity
abstract: Surface and burrow-entrance soils were collected across occupied and unoccupied grassland plots. Environmental DNA was extracted from 10-g subsamples and quantified using a mitochondrial qPCR assay. Detection was strongest in fresh spoil piles and declined after simulated rainfall.
gold_note: Soil eDNA from environmental matrix.

benchmark_record_id: title:environmental dna metabarcoding resolves fish turnover across an estuarine salinity gradient|year:2026
title: Environmental DNA metabarcoding resolves fish turnover across an estuarine salinity gradient
abstract: Triplicate water samples were filtered at 24 sites spanning river, estuary, and nearshore coastal habitats. Environmental DNA metabarcoding recovered freshwater, diadromous, and marine fish assemblages whose composition shifted nonlinearly with salinity. Replicate occupancy was used to control low-frequency detections.
gold_note: Aquatic eDNA metabarcoding.

benchmark_record_id: title:snow environmental dna documents winter use of mountain passes by carnivores|year:2026
title: Snow environmental DNA documents winter use of mountain passes by carnivores
abstract: Fresh snow was collected from tracks and from track-free control transects. Environmental DNA extracted from melted snow was analyzed with carnivore-specific qPCR and vertebrate metabarcoding. The approach confirmed repeated use of two high-elevation passes by lynx and fox.
gold_note: Snow eDNA directly analyzed.

benchmark_record_id: title:environmental dna transport downstream biases abundance inference in a regulated river|year:2026
title: Environmental DNA transport downstream biases abundance inference in a regulated river
abstract: We released caged fish at known densities and sampled environmental DNA at 0, 100, 500, and 1500 m downstream under three discharge conditions. qPCR copy number declined with distance but the decay rate depended strongly on flow. A transport model improved inference of local source abundance.
gold_note: eDNA transport and modeling.

benchmark_record_id: title:environmental rna and dna differ in persistence after fish removal|year:2026
title: Environmental RNA and DNA differ in persistence after fish removal
abstract: Fish were removed from replicated outdoor tanks and water was sampled for 72 h. Environmental DNA and environmental RNA were co-extracted and quantified using matched mitochondrial assays. eRNA declined faster than eDNA, supporting its use as a potentially more time-sensitive signal of recent presence.
gold_note: Direct comparison of eDNA/eRNA persistence.

benchmark_record_id: title:a multiplex lamp assay detects amphibian environmental dna at remote ponds|year:2026
title: A multiplex LAMP assay detects amphibian environmental DNA at remote ponds
abstract: Pond water was filtered in the field and environmental DNA was tested with a two-species colorimetric LAMP assay. Results were compared with laboratory qPCR and nighttime call surveys. The field assay detected both target amphibians at concentrations below those associated with consistent call detections.
gold_note: eDNA field detection method.

benchmark_record_id: title:environmental dna from seawater supports individual haplotype recovery in a spawning aggregation|year:2026
title: Environmental DNA from seawater supports individual haplotype recovery in a spawning aggregation
abstract: High-volume seawater samples were collected around a dense fish spawning aggregation. Targeted capture of environmental DNA followed by deep sequencing recovered multiple mitochondrial haplotypes also observed in fin-clip references. Haplotype recovery declined rapidly outside the aggregation.
gold_note: Population-level information from seawater eDNA.

benchmark_record_id: title:urban stream environmental dna detects pathogen reservoirs in wildlife|year:2026
title: Urban stream environmental DNA detects pathogen reservoirs in wildlife
abstract: Water from urban streams was filtered weekly and environmental DNA was assayed for a wildlife-associated pathogen and its mammalian hosts. Co-detection patterns varied with rainfall and sewer overflow events. Source-tracking analysis suggested that wildlife rather than human wastewater explained most positive sites.
gold_note: Environmental water nucleic acid monitoring.

benchmark_record_id: title:environmental dna occupancy estimates improve monitoring of a rare freshwater snail|year:2026
title: Environmental DNA occupancy estimates improve monitoring of a rare freshwater snail
abstract: At 63 wetlands, three water replicates were collected alongside timed hand searches. Environmental DNA was quantified with a species-specific qPCR assay, and replicate detections were analyzed in a multi-method occupancy model. The eDNA method increased estimated site occupancy while retaining high specificity.
gold_note: Classic rare-species eDNA occupancy study.

benchmark_record_id: title:water-borne mitochondrial traces reveal cryptic fish spawning migrations|year:2026
title: Water-borne mitochondrial traces reveal cryptic fish spawning migrations
abstract: Weekly river-water samples were filtered at six stations before, during, and after the spawning season. DNA retained on filters was extracted and a species-specific mitochondrial marker was quantified by qPCR. Copy numbers rose sharply at upstream stations during the known migration window despite few fish being observed.
gold_note: No eDNA term, but DNA is extracted directly from river water.

benchmark_record_id: title:vertebrate metabarcoding of drinking-water reservoirs recovers surrounding terrestrial fauna|year:2026
title: Vertebrate metabarcoding of drinking-water reservoirs recovers surrounding terrestrial fauna
abstract: Two liters of reservoir water were collected from shore and intake points, filtered, and subjected to vertebrate 12S metabarcoding. Sequence detections included aquatic species and mammals known from camera traps in the surrounding catchment. Extraction blanks and field blanks were used to control contamination.
gold_note: Environmental water DNA without explicit eDNA terminology.

benchmark_record_id: title:dna recovered from cave drip water indicates seasonal bat use|year:2026
title: DNA recovered from cave drip water indicates seasonal bat use
abstract: Drip water was collected beneath cave roosts and at control chambers with no visible bats. Filter-bound DNA was extracted and amplified with a bat-specific mitochondrial assay. Positive detections peaked during maternity-colony occupancy and disappeared several weeks after roost abandonment.
gold_note: DNA directly recovered from environmental water.

benchmark_record_id: title:molecular traces on flower surfaces reveal nocturnal pollinator visitation|year:2026
title: Molecular traces on flower surfaces reveal nocturnal pollinator visitation
abstract: Flowers were swabbed before dusk and again at dawn without capturing visiting animals. DNA from the surface swabs was analyzed using moth- and bat-specific assays. Overnight samples contained substantially more target DNA than pre-exposure controls, matching infrared camera observations.
gold_note: Environmental swabs used to detect organisms; no eDNA keyword.

benchmark_record_id: title:mitochondrial sequences in beach sand identify nesting sea turtles|year:2026
title: Mitochondrial sequences in beach sand identify nesting sea turtles
abstract: Sand was collected from recently disturbed and undisturbed beach patches after nesting events. DNA extracted directly from sand was amplified with short mitochondrial markers and compared with reference haplotypes. Target sequences were recovered from most nests but rarely from background sand.
gold_note: Environmental sand DNA.

benchmark_record_id: title:high-volume seawater filtration recovers whale haplotypes across a migration corridor|year:2026
title: High-volume seawater filtration recovers whale haplotypes across a migration corridor
abstract: Seawater was filtered from ferries crossing a known whale migration route. Targeted mitochondrial amplicons were sequenced from the filters, and haplotypes were compared with regional biopsy archives. Several haplotypes were detected repeatedly without collection of whale tissue during the survey.
gold_note: Seawater DNA used for population inference without eDNA wording.

benchmark_record_id: title:rna recovered from coastal water tracks harmful algal bloom activity|year:2026
title: RNA recovered from coastal water tracks harmful algal bloom activity
abstract: Coastal water was filtered daily during a bloom and total extracellular and cellular RNA on the filters was extracted immediately. Reverse-transcription qPCR targeting a toxin-biosynthesis transcript rose before microscopic cell counts peaked. RNase-treated controls removed the signal.
gold_note: Environmental water RNA used as a biological signal.

benchmark_record_id: title:dust-borne plant dna reconstructs flowering phenology in an agricultural landscape|year:2026
title: Dust-borne plant DNA reconstructs flowering phenology in an agricultural landscape
abstract: Outdoor dust collectors were deployed weekly across farms and field margins. DNA was extracted from settled particles and amplified with a short chloroplast barcode. The temporal abundance of crop and weed sequences broadly followed independent flowering surveys.
gold_note: Air/dust environmental DNA without explicit terminology.

benchmark_record_id: title:river sediment dna indicates upstream spawning by a migratory fish|year:2026
title: River sediment DNA indicates upstream spawning by a migratory fish
abstract: Fine sediment was collected downstream of known and candidate spawning reaches. DNA extracted from sediment was quantified with a species-specific assay and compared with egg surveys. Strong signals occurred downstream of confirmed spawning beds and at two previously undocumented reaches.
gold_note: Sediment environmental DNA without eDNA wording.

benchmark_record_id: title:molecular detection from leech gut contents complements vertebrate surveys|year:2026
title: Molecular detection from leech gut contents complements vertebrate surveys
abstract: Terrestrial leeches were collected from forest floors and pooled for DNA extraction. Vertebrate mitochondrial sequences recovered from blood meals identified mammals not seen during concurrent camera-trap surveys. Detection persistence was evaluated in laboratory-fed leeches.
gold_note: Invertebrate-derived DNA used as an environmental survey substrate; intentionally boundary-like.

benchmark_record_id: title:filter-feeding sponges integrate vertebrate dna signals over reef habitats|year:2026
title: Filter-feeding sponges integrate vertebrate DNA signals over reef habitats
abstract: Small nonlethal sponge biopsies were collected across reef zones, and DNA from material retained by sponge filtration was subjected to vertebrate metabarcoding. Sequence detections reflected local fish and mammal communities over several days of exposure. Tank experiments confirmed uptake of free DNA from surrounding seawater.
gold_note: Biological sampler capturing ambient environmental DNA; difficult boundary.

benchmark_record_id: title:rainwater dna reveals episodic aerial transport of forest arthropods|year:2026
title: Rainwater DNA reveals episodic aerial transport of forest arthropods
abstract: Rain collectors were emptied after individual storms and particulate material was filtered. DNA extracted from the filters was analyzed with arthropod metabarcoding. Community composition differed among wind directions and contained taxa from forest patches several kilometers upwind.
gold_note: Environmental rainwater DNA without eDNA keyword.

benchmark_record_id: title:preservative choice alters recovery of low-copy dna from stream-water filters|year:2026
title: Preservative choice alters recovery of low-copy DNA from stream-water filters
abstract: Stream-water filters were spiked with a low concentration of fish DNA and stored in ethanol, Longmire buffer, silica desiccant, or at ambient temperature. Recovery was measured by qPCR after 1, 7, and 21 days. Desiccation and Longmire buffer best preserved low-copy targets under field-like conditions.
gold_note: Directly transferable preservation study for environmental water DNA.

benchmark_record_id: title:a comparison of pore-size filters for biodiversity dna capture in turbid estuaries|year:2026
title: A comparison of pore-size filters for biodiversity DNA capture in turbid estuaries
abstract: Paired estuarine water samples were filtered through 0.22, 0.45, 1.2, and 5 µm membranes before extraction and multi-marker metabarcoding. Smaller pore sizes increased total DNA yield but clogged rapidly, whereas 1.2 µm filters maximized detected taxa per unit filtration time.
gold_note: Sampling-method benchmark relevant to eDNA.

benchmark_record_id: title:extraction chemistry determines recovery of extracellular rna from wastewater|year:2026
title: Extraction chemistry determines recovery of extracellular RNA from wastewater
abstract: Influent wastewater was split among six extraction protocols that differed in inhibitor removal and carrier chemistry. Recovery of an exogenous RNA standard and three native RNA targets was quantified by RT-ddPCR. The best-performing protocol improved low-copy RNA recovery without increasing inhibition.
gold_note: Wastewater environmental RNA extraction benchmark.

benchmark_record_id: title:primer degeneracy improves detection of freshwater vertebrates in mixed-template water samples|year:2026
title: Primer degeneracy improves detection of freshwater vertebrates in mixed-template water samples
abstract: Synthetic communities and natural river-water extracts were amplified with four 12S primer variants. Sequence recovery, amplification bias, and non-target amplification were quantified. A moderately degenerate primer set increased recovery of amphibians and fishes while retaining low laboratory contamination.
gold_note: Primer validation includes natural environmental water extracts.

benchmark_record_id: title:occupancy-aware thresholding reduces false detections in low-copy metabarcoding data|year:2026
title: Occupancy-aware thresholding reduces false detections in low-copy metabarcoding data
abstract: Replicated lake-water metabarcoding data were analyzed under fixed read-count thresholds, proportional thresholds, and a hierarchical occupancy model. The occupancy model retained rare taxa supported across replicates while rejecting isolated low-level reads from negative controls. Simulation showed improved sensitivity at equal false-positive rates.
gold_note: Bioinformatic/modeling method directly aimed at environmental DNA data.

benchmark_record_id: title:cell-free dna enrichment improves surveillance of antibiotic resistance genes in river water|year:2026
title: Cell-free DNA enrichment improves surveillance of antibiotic resistance genes in river water
abstract: River water was fractionated into cellular and cell-free components before DNA extraction. qPCR and shotgun sequencing showed that several resistance genes were enriched in the extracellular fraction and persisted after removal of intact cells. The workflow was evaluated for low-abundance surveillance targets.
gold_note: Microbial target, but specifically environmental cell-free DNA method.

benchmark_record_id: title:passive membrane samplers integrate wastewater viral rna over 24 hours|year:2026
title: Passive membrane samplers integrate wastewater viral RNA over 24 hours
abstract: Adsorptive membranes were deployed in wastewater channels for 1, 6, and 24 h and compared with grab samples. RNA recovered from the membranes was analyzed by RT-qPCR for three viruses. Longer deployments reduced hour-to-hour variance and improved detection during low-concentration periods.
gold_note: Microbial/viral monitoring with environmental RNA sampling method.

benchmark_record_id: title:freeze-thaw cycles bias quantitative recovery of fecal-marker dna from seawater|year:2026
title: Freeze-thaw cycles bias quantitative recovery of fecal-marker DNA from seawater
abstract: Coastal seawater samples containing low concentrations of microbial source-tracking markers were subjected to repeated freeze-thaw cycles before extraction. Digital PCR showed progressive loss of amplifiable target molecules after the second cycle. The effect depended on whether filters or extracts were frozen.
gold_note: Microbial marker but transferable eDNA preservation/quantification method.

benchmark_record_id: title:a mock-community framework benchmarks taxonomic assignment for environmental amplicons|year:2026
title: A mock-community framework benchmarks taxonomic assignment for environmental amplicons
abstract: Defined mixtures of fish, amphibian, mollusk, and bacterial DNA were added to negative lake-water extracts and sequenced with a common metabarcoding workflow. Six taxonomic classifiers were compared for sensitivity, false assignment, and abundance distortion. Performance was then verified on field water samples.
gold_note: Bioinformatic benchmark anchored to environmental-water metabarcoding.

benchmark_record_id: title:inhibitor removal columns improve qpcr sensitivity in peatland water|year:2026
title: Inhibitor removal columns improve qPCR sensitivity in peatland water
abstract: Water from acidic peatland pools produced delayed amplification and frequent qPCR inhibition. We compared dilution, magnetic-bead cleanup, and inhibitor-removal columns using an internal amplification control and a rare-amphibian assay. Cleanup columns improved detection at low copy number with modest DNA loss.
gold_note: Environmental water qPCR inhibition method.

benchmark_record_id: title:long-read sequencing recovers linked haplotypes from high-molecular-weight lake-water dna|year:2026
title: Long-read sequencing recovers linked haplotypes from high-molecular-weight lake-water DNA
abstract: Lake water was prefiltered to remove large organisms, and extracellular and particle-associated DNA was concentrated by tangential-flow filtration. Long-read sequencing recovered multi-kilobase mitochondrial fragments from several fish species. Fragment length distributions were compared across concentration protocols.
gold_note: Method development on environmental lake-water DNA.

benchmark_record_id: title:field-deployable crispr detection of invasive-fish dna in river water|year:2026
title: Field-deployable CRISPR detection of invasive-fish DNA in river water
abstract: River-water extracts were amplified by recombinase polymerase amplification and read with a CRISPR-Cas fluorescence assay. Analytical specificity was tested against 12 related species and field performance was compared with laboratory qPCR. The assay detected low-copy target DNA at remote sites using a battery-powered reader.
gold_note: Detection-method study on river-water DNA.

benchmark_record_id: title:population genomics of a threatened river fish reveals three management units|year:2026
title: Population genomics of a threatened river fish reveals three management units
abstract: Fin clips were collected from 214 fish across six rivers and genotyped using whole-genome resequencing. Population structure, effective size, and migration were estimated from nuclear SNPs. No water, sediment, or other environmental material was analyzed.
gold_note: Tissue population genomics only.

benchmark_record_id: title:single-cell transcriptomics identifies immune states in oyster gill tissue|year:2026
title: Single-cell transcriptomics identifies immune states in oyster gill tissue
abstract: Gill tissue from oysters exposed to heat stress was dissociated and profiled by single-cell RNA sequencing. Distinct hemocyte and epithelial states were identified, with strong induction of heat-shock and innate-immunity genes.
gold_note: Ordinary tissue transcriptomics.

benchmark_record_id: title:complete mitochondrial genomes clarify relationships among cave salamanders|year:2026
title: Complete mitochondrial genomes clarify relationships among cave salamanders
abstract: Muscle tissue from museum and newly collected specimens was used for mitochondrial genome sequencing. Phylogenetic analyses supported recognition of two deeply divergent lineages. The study did not analyze environmental samples.
gold_note: Specimen sequencing only.

benchmark_record_id: title:gut microbiome composition predicts growth in farmed salmon|year:2026
title: Gut microbiome composition predicts growth in farmed salmon
abstract: Fecal and intestinal samples were collected directly from individually tagged salmon and profiled by 16S rRNA amplicon sequencing. Microbiome composition was associated with feed conversion and growth rate.
gold_note: Host-associated microbiome, not environmental monitoring.

benchmark_record_id: title:metagenome-assembled genomes reveal metabolic exchange in the human oral microbiome|year:2026
title: Metagenome-assembled genomes reveal metabolic exchange in the human oral microbiome
abstract: Dental plaque samples from 120 participants were shotgun sequenced and assembled into metagenome-assembled genomes. Co-occurrence and pathway analysis identified candidate metabolic dependencies among oral bacteria.
gold_note: Human host-associated metagenomics.

benchmark_record_id: title:reference genome assembly for an invasive freshwater snail|year:2026
title: Reference genome assembly for an invasive freshwater snail
abstract: High-molecular-weight DNA from a single laboratory-reared snail was sequenced with long reads and Hi-C. The chromosome-scale assembly provides a resource for future ecological and conservation studies.
gold_note: Individual reference genome.

benchmark_record_id: title:blood-based cell-free dna detects relapse in canine lymphoma|year:2026
title: Blood-based cell-free DNA detects relapse in canine lymphoma
abstract: Plasma cell-free DNA was isolated from dogs during chemotherapy and analyzed for tumor-associated mutations. Molecular relapse preceded clinical progression in a subset of cases.
gold_note: Clinical plasma cfDNA, not environmental DNA.

benchmark_record_id: title:rna-seq of drought-stressed leaves identifies conserved stress pathways|year:2026
title: RNA-seq of drought-stressed leaves identifies conserved stress pathways
abstract: Leaves from greenhouse-grown plants were sampled before and after controlled drought. Bulk RNA sequencing revealed coordinated regulation of abscisic-acid signaling and osmotic-stress genes.
gold_note: Plant tissue transcriptomics.

benchmark_record_id: title:microsatellite markers reveal fine-scale dispersal in a coastal crab|year:2026
title: Microsatellite markers reveal fine-scale dispersal in a coastal crab
abstract: Leg tissue from adult crabs was genotyped at 18 microsatellite loci. Assignment tests indicated limited dispersal among neighboring bays despite a prolonged larval phase.
gold_note: Tissue genetics only.

benchmark_record_id: title:comparative genomics of cultured cyanobacteria identifies toxin gene loss|year:2026
title: Comparative genomics of cultured cyanobacteria identifies toxin gene loss
abstract: Twenty-four cyanobacterial strains isolated from lakes were grown in culture and sequenced. Comparative genomics revealed recurrent loss of toxin biosynthesis genes in laboratory-maintained lineages.
gold_note: Cultured isolates; no environmental nucleic-acid analysis.

benchmark_record_id: title:museum genomics reconstructs historical diversity of an extinct island bird|year:2026
title: Museum genomics reconstructs historical diversity of an extinct island bird
abstract: DNA was extracted from toe pads of museum skins collected between 1880 and 1910. Genome-wide data were used to estimate historical heterozygosity and relatedness.
gold_note: Museum specimen DNA only.

benchmark_record_id: title:whole-blood transcriptomics predicts migration timing in a songbird|year:2026
title: Whole-blood transcriptomics predicts migration timing in a songbird
abstract: Blood was collected from captured birds before migration and analyzed by RNA sequencing. Expression signatures related to lipid metabolism predicted departure date.
gold_note: Blood transcriptomics.

benchmark_record_id: title:amplicon sequencing of fungal endophytes across tree leaves|year:2026
title: Amplicon sequencing of fungal endophytes across tree leaves
abstract: Surface-sterilized leaves from five tree species were homogenized and fungal ITS regions were amplified. Endophyte communities differed strongly among host species and canopy positions.
gold_note: Host tissue microbiome/endophytes.

benchmark_record_id: title:genome-wide association identifies salinity-tolerance loci in tilapia|year:2026
title: Genome-wide association identifies salinity-tolerance loci in tilapia
abstract: Fish from a breeding population were challenged at different salinities and genotyped from fin tissue. Association mapping identified loci linked to survival and ion regulation.
gold_note: Individual genotyping/GWAS.

benchmark_record_id: title:crispr knockout confirms a pigmentation gene in zebrafish|year:2026
title: CRISPR knockout confirms a pigmentation gene in zebrafish
abstract: Embryos were injected with CRISPR reagents targeting a candidate pigmentation gene. Mutant phenotypes and transcript levels were measured in laboratory-reared fish.
gold_note: Laboratory genetics.

benchmark_record_id: title:phylogeography of a marine turtle using nesting-female blood samples|year:2026
title: Phylogeography of a marine turtle using nesting-female blood samples
abstract: Blood was collected from nesting females at nine rookeries and mitochondrial haplotypes were sequenced. Population differentiation supported natal homing across regional nesting sites.
gold_note: Blood/tissue phylogeography.

benchmark_record_id: title:visual surveys remain effective for monitoring stream fish under low-flow conditions|year:2026
title: Visual surveys remain effective for monitoring stream fish under low-flow conditions
abstract: We compared electrofishing and underwater video across 30 streams. Environmental DNA is discussed as a promising complementary approach for future surveys, but no molecular samples were collected or analyzed in this study.
gold_note: Explicit eDNA mention only in discussion/future work.

benchmark_record_id: title:conservation priorities for cave fauna under groundwater extraction|year:2026
title: Conservation priorities for cave fauna under groundwater extraction
abstract: Species distributions from historical records and visual surveys were combined with groundwater models to identify priority caves. We highlight environmental DNA as a potential tool for filling distribution gaps, but the present analysis contains no DNA data.
gold_note: eDNA proposed, not used.

benchmark_record_id: title:a review of molecular tools for freshwater biodiversity assessment|year:2026
title: A review of molecular tools for freshwater biodiversity assessment
abstract: This narrative review summarizes barcoding, metabarcoding, environmental DNA, transcriptomics, and genomic approaches used in freshwater ecology. Published case studies are compared conceptually, but no new environmental samples or nucleic-acid data are generated.
gold_note: Method-relevant review but no actual environmental DNA analysis.

benchmark_record_id: title:camera traps and acoustic recorders reveal mammal responses to road construction|year:2026
title: Camera traps and acoustic recorders reveal mammal responses to road construction
abstract: Mammals were monitored with cameras and autonomous acoustic sensors before and after road construction. Environmental DNA sampling is mentioned among alternative noninvasive methods in the introduction, but was not part of the field design.
gold_note: eDNA keyword present but unused.

benchmark_record_id: title:benchmarking fish biodiversity indicators from conventional survey data|year:2026
title: Benchmarking fish biodiversity indicators from conventional survey data
abstract: We evaluated richness, occupancy, and community turnover metrics using 15 years of electrofishing records. The discussion compares these indicators with estimates reported by environmental DNA studies, but the current dataset contains only conventional survey observations.
gold_note: eDNA appears only as comparison.

benchmark_record_id: title:effects of turbidity on electrofishing detection probability|year:2026
title: Effects of turbidity on electrofishing detection probability
abstract: Repeated electrofishing surveys were conducted across a turbidity gradient. We note that environmental DNA can perform well in visually difficult habitats, yet no water samples were processed for molecular analysis.
gold_note: No molecular work despite relevant habitat discussion.

benchmark_record_id: title:microbial community succession in activated sludge under altered aeration|year:2026
title: Microbial community succession in activated sludge under altered aeration
abstract: Activated-sludge biomass was sampled directly from treatment reactors and analyzed by 16S sequencing to characterize bacterial community succession. Although wastewater environmental DNA surveillance is mentioned as a separate application, the study focuses on reactor microbiome ecology and does not evaluate extracellular DNA, detection methods, or monitoring targets.
gold_note: Generic wastewater microbiome, intentionally excluded by curation policy.

benchmark_record_id: title:seasonal soil microbiome turnover along an elevation gradient|year:2026
title: Seasonal soil microbiome turnover along an elevation gradient
abstract: Bulk soil from 60 plots was extracted for 16S and ITS amplicon sequencing. Bacterial and fungal communities varied with temperature and soil moisture. The work is a general microbial community ecology study and does not evaluate environmental DNA detection, preservation, quantification, or monitoring methodology.
gold_note: Environmental DNA physically exists in soil extracts, but study is generic microbial profiling.

benchmark_record_id: title:shotgun metagenomics profiles antibiotic resistance in hospital wastewater|year:2026
title: Shotgun metagenomics profiles antibiotic resistance in hospital wastewater
abstract: Wastewater samples were shotgun sequenced to characterize taxonomic composition and resistance genes. The analysis focuses on resistome structure and mobile genetic elements, without evaluating environmental nucleic-acid sampling, target detection performance, preservation, quantification, or surveillance sensitivity.
gold_note: Generic metagenomics of an environmental sample; primary curation label is out_of_scope.

benchmark_record_id: title:metatranscriptomics reveals carbon cycling in coastal sediments|year:2026
title: Metatranscriptomics reveals carbon cycling in coastal sediments
abstract: RNA was extracted from coastal sediment cores and sequenced to profile microbial gene expression across redox zones. The study addresses microbial metabolism and biogeochemistry and does not evaluate organism detection, monitoring, RNA persistence, sampling methodology, or transferable eRNA workflows.
gold_note: Environmental RNA source but generic microbial metatranscriptomics.

benchmark_record_id: title:environmental dna terminology in ecological publications has expanded rapidly|year:2026
title: Environmental DNA terminology in ecological publications has expanded rapidly
abstract: We performed a bibliometric analysis of titles, abstracts, and keywords from 9,000 publications containing terms related to environmental DNA. Citation networks and topic models were used to describe growth of the field. No environmental samples or biological DNA measurements were analyzed.
gold_note: About eDNA literature, not eDNA data.

benchmark_record_id: title:machine learning predicts suitable habitat for an invasive carp|year:2026
title: Machine learning predicts suitable habitat for an invasive carp
abstract: Occurrence records from fisheries surveys were combined with temperature, discharge, and land-use predictors in an ensemble habitat model. Existing environmental DNA detections from previously published studies are cited to motivate surveillance, but no molecular data are included in the model.
gold_note: No eDNA data actually analyzed.

benchmark_record_id: title:comparing environmental dna and electrofishing: a protocol for a planned multicenter study|year:2026
title: Comparing environmental DNA and electrofishing: a protocol for a planned multicenter study
abstract: This protocol describes a future comparison of water filtration, qPCR, metabarcoding, and electrofishing across 50 rivers. Recruitment of field teams has begun, but no samples have yet been collected and no empirical results are presented.
gold_note: Protocol only; no actual environmental DNA analysis yet.

benchmark_record_id: title:meta-analysis of environmental dna detection probability across freshwater taxa|year:2026
title: Meta-analysis of environmental DNA detection probability across freshwater taxa
abstract: Published effect sizes from 138 studies were extracted to test how water volume, assay type, and target ecology influence reported detection probability. The study synthesizes environmental DNA results but performs no new collection or analysis of environmental nucleic-acid samples.
gold_note: Secondary synthesis only, no actual environmental sample analysis.

benchmark_record_id: title:freshwater biodiversity policy recommendations for national monitoring programs|year:2026
title: Freshwater biodiversity policy recommendations for national monitoring programs
abstract: Experts evaluated conventional nets, hydroacoustics, remote sensing, and environmental DNA as candidate monitoring technologies. The report develops a decision framework from published evidence and stakeholder workshops; it does not generate or reanalyze molecular sample data.
gold_note: eDNA is a discussed technology, not analyzed data.

benchmark_record_id: title:dna barcoding improves identification of larval fishes from plankton nets|year:2026
title: DNA barcoding improves identification of larval fishes from plankton nets
abstract: Individual larvae collected by plankton nets were sorted under a microscope, dissected one by one, and Sanger sequenced for COI barcodes. Species assignments were compared with morphology. Environmental DNA metabarcoding is discussed as an alternative, but no bulk water or environmental DNA samples were analyzed.
gold_note: Individual specimens, not eDNA.

title: Molecular surveillance of rare amphibians across seasonal wetlands
abstract: Samples were collected from 27 wetlands and analyzed with species-specific qPCR. Positive detections were compared with nighttime call surveys. The abstract does not state whether the molecular samples were water, sediment, tissue, swabs, or another material.
gold_note: Cannot establish whether DNA came directly from an environmental matrix.

title: DNA-based detection improves monitoring of an elusive cave fish
abstract: Field samples from occupied and candidate caves were processed for mitochondrial DNA detection and compared with visual surveys. The sampling material and collection procedure are not described in the abstract.
gold_note: Could be water eDNA or organism-derived material.

title: RNA signatures track pathogen activity in municipal monitoring samples
abstract: Weekly samples from a municipal surveillance program were analyzed by RT-qPCR for pathogen transcripts, and signal intensity was associated with reported cases. The abstract does not specify whether samples were wastewater, clinical material, pooled swabs, or another source.
gold_note: Monitoring context suggests wastewater but sample type is omitted.

title: Metabarcoding reveals unexpected vertebrate diversity at tropical field sites
abstract: Material collected at 20 forest sites was amplified with vertebrate 12S primers and sequenced. The resulting community profiles included mammals, birds, and reptiles. The abstract does not specify whether the source material was water, soil, leeches, feces, bulk tissue, or another substrate.
gold_note: Metabarcoding source is not stated.

title: Low-copy mitochondrial DNA predicts recent presence of a threatened mammal
abstract: DNA was recovered from noninvasive field samples collected along transects and quantified with ddPCR. Detection declined with days since independently confirmed animal presence. The abstract does not identify whether samples were soil, snow, hair, feces, or swabs.
gold_note: Could be eDNA or organism-derived traces.

title: A molecular assay increases detection of freshwater parasites
abstract: Samples from streams were tested with a newly developed qPCR assay and compared with microscopy. Analytical specificity and sensitivity were evaluated, but the abstract does not explain whether DNA was extracted from water, captured hosts, isolated parasites, or mixed material.
gold_note: Insufficient methods to decide environmental DNA use.

title: Sequence-based monitoring detects seasonal changes in coastal biodiversity
abstract: Monthly samples were sequenced with multiple barcode markers, and beta diversity showed strong seasonal turnover. The abstract names the sampling stations but omits the sampled material and whether organisms were individually sorted before extraction.
gold_note: Could be environmental metabarcoding or bulk-organism metabarcoding.

title: Molecular traces reveal presence of an invasive freshwater species
abstract: A short mitochondrial marker was detected at five locations where conventional surveys were negative. Field and laboratory controls were included, but the abstract does not state what environmental or biological material was collected for DNA extraction.
gold_note: Likely eDNA, but abstract alone is insufficient by benchmark rule.
